scope: Method 2 conditional confirmation speed combined with Method 1 RULE_HALF; frozen before this experiment's portfolio results
hypothesis: Short/long momentum disagreement can justify faster confirmation of existing state transitions without replacing their entry conditions or credit/deep/financial protection rules.
reference: RULE_HALF from qqq_guarded_reentry_lock_20261026.json is retained as a distinct reproducible strategy variant and the main incremental benchmark.

momentum.definition: QQQ close-to-close return minus BIL close-to-close return, same trailing sessions
momentum.warmup: computed on prepared full historical prices before selecting comparison dates; turning-point streak starts at first comparison session

confirmation_semantics: Existing candidate's consecutive native-condition days are retained. On each completed close choose accelerated confirmation only if the relevant disagreement has lasted >=2 consecutive sessions; otherwise restore original confirmation. Original transition conditions and priority never change. Uninitialized transitions are unchanged.
protections: Do not change credit_guard, deep_guard, deep_credit_peak, financial_guard or structural_bear_mode definitions/targets; do not accelerate valuation DEFENSE release. Method 1 still refuses additions in hard-protected states and cancels on a failed price gate. Adaptive BEAR exit may happen earlier but every contemporaneous guard target still has original priority.
comparison_design: 2x2 BASE/REENTRY/SPEED/COMBINED plus predeclared sell/buy ablations. ALWAYS_FAST_COMBINED removes only turning-point gating to distinguish conditional adaptation from generic confirmation shortening; diagnostic, not a selected replacement.
execution: Completed close, next open, identical pending target keeps original deadline, new different target replaces it; initial investment next open even under delay. Actual changed holdings fed to original strategy every session. Fractional shares and adjusted OHLC.

incremental_gate.subperiod_rule: report all contributions and concentration; improvement in every period is not required
incremental_gate.meaning: historical incremental support for this fixed combination, not guaranteed future outperformance

checks: BASE and REENTRY reproduce prior runner under every scenario
actual-holdings feedback and no top-up preserved
all MAIN profiles full-path prefix invariance
limitations: Previously inspected historical data, not fresh out-of-sample evidence
No optimization of momentum horizons or confirmations
Daily price availability sufficient; no new paid data or live model
This is a local adaptation of a literature idea, not reproduction of the published multi-asset strategies
